QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Colossal Problems
QuestInfo.0: You hear the voice of the #bStone Colossus#.
QuestInfo.1: Stone Colossus is lonely and needs a sympathetic ear.
QuestInfo.2: Turns out the Stone Colossus is really worried about a darkness growing within, despite it being a good entity.

1.msg: #b(There's a loud echo. Is it coming from the rock mountain?)

3.msg: #b (Wait, it sounds like the voice of the Stone Colossus. What is it saying?)

4.msg: Someone... Please listen to me... I'm lonely...

yes.0: Ah, someone who can understand me.
yes.1: So far, nobody could understand me. Maybe my voice is too big...

no.0: No... Only wind... No one here...
